SJ15-08.name: Burning Lance Assault
SJ15-08.effect:
[Flash]
During this turn, give one of your Spirits +4000 BP. When only the opposing Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed by that Spirit via BP comparison, draw two cards.

BS24-036.name: Burst Turtle
BS24-036.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is destroyed by the Opponent]
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2]
Cards can't be discarded from either player's deck. Also, if you control any Ultimate, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit effects.

SJ15-06.name: The ThreeVassalsDragon Fuse Cland
SJ15-06.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 5000 BP. If [Soul Core](Soul Core) was used to pay the summon cost, increase the limit of this "BP Destruction Effect" by +5000.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing braved Brave. Or, destroy an opposing Nexus.

SJ15-05.name: The ThreeVassalsDragon Ingenious Hyoubu
SJ15-05.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return all "Ultimate Trooper" family Spirit cards from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
While you control [The ThreeVassalsDragon Lancefighting Shougen], [The ThreeVassalsDragon Ingenious Hyoubu] and [The ThreeVassalsDragon Fuse Cland], at least one of each, all [The WarParamountWarDragon BuraiDragon] in your Hand becomes Cost 4.

SJ15-04.name: The ThreeVassalsDragon Lancefighting Shougen
SJ15-04.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit. If [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, also, draw two cards.

SJ15-07R.name: The WarParamountWarDragon BuraiDragon
SJ15-07R.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Ultimate Trooper" family Spirit attacks, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with BP equal or inferior to that Spirit's.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By sending cores from your Life to any of your Spirits until you have one Life left, during this turn, all your "Ultimate Trooper" family Spirits get +5000 BP and one extra Red symbol.

SJ15-02.name: The WarParamount MaximumDragon
SJ15-02.effect: This card is limited to one copy per deck.

BS24-106.name: Ultimate Wall
BS24-106.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
When this battle ends, end the Attack Step. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
Return three opposing Cost 3 or less Spirits to the Hand.
